constraints.name: activity_board_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: activity_task_board_fkey

constraints.name: comments_task_id_fkey

constraints.name: credentials_access_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((token_type = 'api-key'::text) AND (board_ids IS NULL) AND (scopes = '{}'::text[]) AND (oauth_client_id IS NULL) AND (resource IS NULL)) OR ((token_type = 'oauth'::text) AND (scopes <@ ARRAY['read'::text, 'write'::text]) AND ('read'::text = ANY (scopes)))))

constraints.name: credentials_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: notifications_task_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (task_id) REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: oauth_owner_required
constraints.definition: CHECK (((code_hash IS NULL) OR (consumed_at IS NOT NULL) OR (user_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: oauth_requests_credential_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (credential_id) REFERENCES credentials(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

constraints.name: oauth_requests_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: tasks_board_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (board_id) REFERENCES boards(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
